abilities.name: Dig
abilities.description: Excavate up to two selected tiles, 800 ms each, gaining one rock per tile and preparing the ground.

cast.description: A shovel blade biting soil, two short earthy scrapes with tiny stone clicks. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

impact.description: Loose earth settling and a small discovered rock tumbling into a pouch, gentle resource chime. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

notes: Actor tag is one 800 ms excavation. Repeat it for a second selected tile; do not replace the two-tile cap with area digging.
Loot chance is 70%; rock gain is guaranteed per successful tile. Persistent dug ground is terrain state.

abilities.name: Boulder
abilities.description: Spend two rocks to launch a 2×2 rolling boulder at four tiles per second until a solid obstruction.

cast.description: Heavy earth splitting and a large stone mass forming with a compact magical rumble. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

impact.description: A weighty stone collision, crunchy rock fracture and debris settling into earth. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

sustain.description: Seamless heavy boulder rolling over gritty soil, rhythmic coarse stone rumble with small debris, no impacts. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

notes: Canonical filename remains bolder; display name is Boulder.
Base boulder deals 200 damage once per enemy and gathers destructible resources. No spread, homing or child boulders.

abilities.name: Border
abilities.description: Spend one rock on dug ground to grow a one-cell projectile-deflecting barrier after a 1500 ms cast.

cast.description: Thorny vines twisting up through pebbles, organic growth creaks and low earthy magic. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

impact.description: A sharp projectile deflection ping mixed with a woody thorn crack and a short magical ricochet. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

charge.description: Low earthen rumble rises for one and a half seconds as roots gather beneath prepared soil. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

sustain.description: Seamless very quiet vine and leaf rustle with faint earthen resonance, a living defensive barrier. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

notes: One-cell barrier persists 60 seconds and deflects friendly and hostile projectiles.
Preview must require/stage dug ground; no upgraded 2×2 barrier or melee-health bonus.

abilities.name: Symbiosis
abilities.description: Plant a seed node and feed resources to grow its healing strength and coverage.

cast.description: A seed tucked into soft earth with a tiny organic sprout pop. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

impact.description: A bioluminescent mushroom opening with a gentle natural healing chime and leafy creak. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

sustain.description: Seamless soft resource absorption hum with slow watery healing chimes and subtle organic growth. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

notes: Canonical filename remains mushroom; source document display title is Symbiosis.
Seed does not heal. Further growth/healing requires resource investment, not elapsed animation time alone. Preview labels staged feeding.
No network or World Tree upgrades; five tags are base growth states. Gold semantics vary within the brief; art shows resource feeding without asserting the conflicting formula.
